article.title_es: Iglesia St. Mark the Evangelist: despensa de alimentos en Manhattan
article.title_en: St. Mark the Evangelist Church: food pantry in Manhattan
article.summary_es: La Iglesia St. Mark the Evangelist tiene una despensa de alimentos en Harlem, Manhattan. Abre los sábados por la mañana, solo el 1.º, 2.º, 3.º y 4.º sábado del mes.
article.summary_en: St. Mark the Evangelist Church has a food pantry in Harlem, Manhattan. It is open Saturday mornings, only on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Saturday of the month.
how_they_help_es: Es una despensa de alimentos que aparece en el mapa Food Help NYC de la ciudad.
Está en 67 W 138th St, Nueva York, NY 10037, en Manhattan.
Solo abre el 1.º, 2.º, 3.º y 4.º sábado del mes.
Puede llamar al (212) 281-4931 para preguntar qué alimentos entrega y qué necesita para recibirlos.
how_they_help_en: It is a food pantry listed on the City's Food Help NYC map.
It is located at 67 W 138th St, New York, NY 10037, in Manhattan.
It is open Saturdays from 10am to 12pm.
It is only open on the 1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Saturday of the month.
You can call (212) 281-4931 to ask what food is given and what is needed to receive it.
visit_tips_es: Vaya un sábado entre 10am y 12pm, pero recuerde que no abre el quinto sábado del mes.
Llame antes al (212) 281-4931 para confirmar el horario y preguntar qué alimentos hay.
La página no indica qué documentos se necesitan, así que es mejor preguntar por teléfono.
visit_tips_en: Go on a Saturday between 10am and 12pm, but remember it is closed on a fifth Saturday of the month.
Call ahead at (212) 281-4931 to confirm the hours and ask what food is available.
The listing does not say what documents are needed, so it is best to ask by phone.
